message: The other day, I was in the kitchen trying to whip up a fancy dinner when I suddenly remembered that I hadn't tested our smoke alarm in ages. So, there I was, half-stirring a pot and half-running to the hallway, still in my apron, to press that little button. Of course, it went off at the most inconvenient time—just as I was trying to impress my family! We all had a good laugh about my culinary skills and my less-than-stellar fire safety checks. Lesson learned: even the best chefs need a fire escape plan. How often do you check your smoke alarms?
